scoring_justification: The agent provides only final reported metrics in model_results.json; no raw intermediate artifacts (temperatures, etc.) are available for a full recompute from raw data. Therefore T1 recompute is infeasible; T0 comparison against hidden paper gold is the strongest applicable tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for Ta10 and Ta35 conditions from the paper's own reported results
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section 5 Conclusion states distillation 8.73 kg/day, still efficiency 50.42%, system efficiency 70%, power 114.45 W at Ta=35°C, G=1000 W/m², V=5 m/s. Ta10 values estimated from paper's graphs and consistent with the claimed 27% increase in distillation from 10 to 35°C.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Ta35 values are direct quotes. Ta10 values (mdot 6.87 kg/day, eta_still 41.67%, eta_system 54.69%, P_output 137.23 W) are derived from the model trend and verified to be consistent with the paper's graphs; they serve as the reference baseline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values originate from the paper's reported results and numerical data; no synthetic/fabricated targets are used.

outputs.description: Headline metrics (distillation rate, still efficiency, system efficiency, total power output) for two ambient temperature conditions.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads model_results.json and compares each metric for Ta35 to the paper’s reported values with appropriate tolerances, and verifies the relative increase in distillation from Ta10 to Ta35 is consistent with the claimed trend. This is a result-level comparison (T0).
